title: Executive Employment Agreement with IP Assignment, Confidentiality, and Restrictive Covenants
whenToUse: Use when onboarding C-suite, senior leadership, or tech key personnel requiring comprehensive IP assignment, non-solicitation, and garden leave clauses.
variantComparisonNote: Comprehensive executive contract. Distinct from basic junior offer letter or transactional independent contractor agreement.
youWillNeed: Compensation structure, job roles and scope, reporting hierarchy, stock option / ESOP schedule.
legalBasis: Indian Contract Act, 1872 (Sections 27 & 73); Copyright Act, 1957 (Section 17 - Work for Hire); Specific Relief Act, 1963.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Clear appointment, reporting structure, and probationary terms
Compensation, variable pay, and statutory deductions clause
Strict Work-For-Hire Intellectual Property Assignment under Copyright Act, 1957
Reasonable non-solicitation and confidentiality covenants under Section 27 Contract Act
Dispute resolution clause specifying governing law and arbitration

aiBlocks.title: Appointment Scope, Duties & Compensation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft appointment clause detailing fiduciary obligations, reporting lines, fixed and variable CTC of ₹{{FACT:annual_compensation}}/- per annum.

aiBlocks.title: Comprehensive IP Assignment & Trade Secrets
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft strict work-for-hire IP assignment assigning all software, patents, and copyright to {{FACT:company_name}}, with perpetual confidentiality.

aiBlocks.title: Termination, Garden Leave & Non-Solicitation
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft termination for cause and convenience, 90-day notice, garden leave provision, and 24-month non-solicitation of clients/employees.
